requirement: The framework shall allow users to build MuJoCo-based simulators for human-computer interaction tasks from YAML configuration by combining the selected biomechanical model, interaction-task environment, and perception components using the corresponding MuJoCo XML model definitions.

The framework shall allow developers to add new biomechanical models, perception capabilities, and interaction tasks for use in simulator builds, and shall support perception modalities including egocentric vision and proprioception.
The framework shall package built simulators as self-contained units that can be loaded and run independently and used with software compatible with the OpenAI Gym interface.

The framework shall allow users to evaluate a saved training run from the command line or a script, load its simulator and a specified model checkpoint or the latest checkpoint when none is specified, apply the configured evaluation parameters, and save enabled logs and recordings in the run folder's evaluate directory, creating that directory when needed. When action logging is enabled, it shall write the actions to the configured action log file.

The framework shall allow users to train biomechanical user models or control policies for configured interaction tasks using the reinforcement-learning algorithm and training settings specified in the simulator configuration, and save the resulting training-run outputs and model checkpoints.
The simulator shall accept biomechanical action inputs in the range [-1, 1] and constrain applied motor and muscle actuator control values to the range [0, 1].
